lesson-motion-remotion-spring-damping.trigger_condition: remotion TSX component uses spring() physics
lesson-motion-remotion-spring-damping.recommendation: Always declare damping >= 10 and mass >= 0.1 in Remotion spring configs to prevent oscillations.

lesson-motion-kinetic-reuse-preference.trigger_condition: request mentions typography text motion or animated subtitles
lesson-motion-kinetic-reuse-preference.recommendation: Prefer REUSE of canonical 'motion.kinetic_typography' over creating unverified text animation skills.

lesson-security-no-os-paths-in-remotion.trigger_condition: remotion TSX component references asset paths
lesson-security-no-os-paths-in-remotion.recommendation: Enforce staticFile() or relative URLs; forbid raw OS drive paths (e.g. C:\...).
